title: Relation
summary: A relation records which tuples of objects stand in a chosen connection.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared set-like metalanguage context is fixed.

content.plain: A relation records which tuples of objects stand in a chosen connection.
content.exact: An n-ary relation on sets X₁,…,Xₙ is a subset R⊆X₁×⋯×Xₙ; writing R(x₁,…,xₙ) means the tuple belongs to R.
content.example: The less-than relation contains pairs (a,b) for which a<b.
content.caveat: In type theory or categorical settings, relations may be represented differently.
